title.suggested: Tom Allen Defeats Gilbert in Glove Fight

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat reprinted the London Sportsman's report that Allen easily beat the novice Tompkins Gilbert of Lincoln in a seven-round glove fight, Gilbert refusing to continue after fouling him.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Saturday Morning, November 17, 1877. Reprint from the London Sportsman

facts.fact: Allen beat Tompkins Gilbert of Lincoln in a glove fight for the championship in seven rounds lasting 16 min 25 sec; Gilbert, who had hit low, refused to come back after the seventh
The London Sportsman wrote that Allen fought splendidly but much of the elasticity of his youth had departed and his condition was not the best

notes: Fight date not stated here; article 598/599 give October 29, 1877. Duration 16:25 here vs 16:45 in article 601.
